desktop.url.unknownApp.title: Unknown application
desktop.url.unknownApp.message: There is no application “{id}” in your profiles.
desktop.notify.disconnected.title: {app} disconnected
desktop.notify.disconnected.body: {reason}. It wasn’t restarted. Open Waylauncher to start it again; the old session can’t be recovered.
desktop.notify.failed.title: {app} couldn’t start
desktop.quit.detail: They will close on their host. Unsaved work in them will be lost. Cocoa-Way keeps running.
desktop.stop.title: Stop {app}?
desktop.stop.detail.single: This ends the application on {host}. Unsaved work in it will be lost. It won’t be restarted.
desktop.stop.detail.multiple: This ends {n} instances on {host}. Unsaved work in them will be lost. They won’t be restarted.
